audience: digital sellers who run a Sell.app store with license keys and coupons

useCases.title: Find the license key a customer bought
useCases.text: Filter the license keys by key text, customer email, product or order. Open one by its numeric ID.

useCases.title: Review recent orders and their totals
useCases.text: List the orders with customer and payment summaries. Open one order to read its totals and status timeline.

useCases.title: Check which products sell best
useCases.text: List the store's products, filtered by visibility or by sales, and open one product by its ID.

useCases.title: Track coupon use and payment disputes
useCases.text: List the coupon codes and read the usage record of one coupon. List the payment disputes, most recent first.

useCases.title: Check store settings and key permissions
useCases.text: Read the store configuration and its status flags. Check which abilities the API key has for this store.
